text_block_list.text:
Huh? The edge of that flowerbed over there...
A brick is sticking out, that's dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'll hammer it back into shape.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ghhk-hh-hhh...!!
How could I... make such a blunder...?!
Believe seems a bit tired. It might be best to review her schedule.
